description: Letiště v Karlovarském kraji is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Karlovarský kraj. The data set contains an overview of national, international airports and significant areas for sport flying facilities in the Karlovy Vary Region. Coverage: Karlovarský kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Airports in the Karlovy Vary Region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Karlovarský kraj. Its keywords include vnitrostátní letiště, Karlovarský kraj, plocha pro sportovní létající zařízení, mezinárodní letiště, letiště. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV, ZIP, KML, GPKG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70891168/d55f9e857d4be6eacec750c2771596c0/distribuce/f7ca1ce808ee8473647157b4868356ad/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
